title: Damage Repair Aloe Vera Hair Oil

details.description: Say goodbye to dry, frizzy, and rough hair with Hair & Care's Triple Blend Oil, enriched with Aloe Vera, Olive Oil, and Green Tea. This non-sticky, lightweight hair oil is suitable for all hair types, whether straight, curly, thin, or thick, and repairs up to 100% damage caused by styling heat, colouring, chemicals, pollution, sun, and hard water. The triple-blend nourishing ingredients work together to moisturise hair, prevent scalp irritation, and add shine to damaged hair. Aloe Vera soothes itchy scalp and deep conditions the hair, while Olive Oil, rich in Vitamin E and antioxidants, gives strong and nourished hair. Green Tea, with its anti-fungal and anti-inflammatory properties, improves hair health. Use it after washing to style your hair with ease, or as a regular treatment to keep your hair soft, smooth, and bouncy. With its classic, loved fragrance, this hair oil is the perfect solution for damage-free hair.
details.usageInstructions:
1. Squeeze gently to get the desired quantity on your palm.
2. Massage your scalp gently with your fingers.
3. Apply the oil along the length of your hair from roots to tips.

details.description: Why use just any hair oil when you can experience the benefits of Almond Oil? Hair & Care combines the goodness of almond oil in a trusted, non-sticky formula, offering you a convenient way to care for your hair. Try the new Hair & Care Almond Hair Oil and enjoy the nourishing benefits of both almond oil and Vitamin E. Almonds are known for their numerous health benefits and are rich in essential nutrients that help support hair health and promote hair growth. When combined with Vitamin E, a powerful antioxidant that helps nourish and strengthen hair, it forms an effective blend for healthier-looking hair. This oil helps make your hair silky, smooth and strong. Its light and non-sticky formula ensures easy application. For best results, deeply massage the oil into your hair and leave it overnight before washing, or simply apply a few drops after washing to keep your hair manageable.
details.usageInstructions:
Before wash: Deeply massage into the scalp to provide nourishment.
After wash: Dab a few drops onto hair to make it more manageable.

details.description: Why use just an Almond Oil when you can get the benefit of 2 oils - Walnut and Almond Oil? Hair & Care combines the goodness of Almond Oil and Walnut Oil in one bottle and still comes in Hair & Care's trusted, non-sticky format. Try out the new Hair & Care hair oil and experience the goodness of Walnut Oil, Almond Oil and Vitamin E. Walnuts also contain a high amount of selenium which promote a healthy scalp in addition to healthy hair. This along with Almond, which is known for its nourishment credentials, becomes a potent combination. Vitamin E is known to be a powerful antioxidant that helps nourish the hair making it stronger. Try out the Hair & Care Walnut and Almond oil for silky strong hair. Its light and non-sticky formula ensure that it is super easy to apply.

After Wash: Dab a few drops for manageable hair

details.description: Hair & Care is the youth and contemporary teenage girl's choice as she takes her first steps into the adult world. Hair & Care Silk n Shine Hair Serum offers you the confidence of parlour-like transformed hair. Enriched with the natural goodness of Fruit Vitamins, coats each strand, detangles knots, and makes your hair soft, smooth, and silky.
